status: Current user decision; supersedes the withdrawn request to make .photato a PSD binary

photoshop.target: 100% PSD support as a separate file format
photoshop.current_status: Incomplete; full supported-feature, editability, profile/metadata and independent Photoshop interoperability remain required
acceptance: Open, edit, save and reopen PSD as PSD through native Swift and both applicable APIs.
Preserve Photoshop-editable structures, profiles, resources and rendering across independently verified Photoshop round trips.
Keep unsupported cases and any data-loss risks explicit until their implementation and qualification are complete.
Do not treat native .photato support or passing native-archive tests as proof of complete PSD support.

implementation_effect: Retain the existing distinct native archive and PSD codec paths; no native serializer conversion is requested. Continue separate PSD coverage in the existing major-format workflow.
supersedes: The immediately preceding user request for .photato/.psd binary compatibility was explicitly withdrawn. No serializer migration was performed in response.
